verdict: Paid ads remain offline; 8 overdue setup milestones are blocking relaunch.
narrative: No spend ran on Meta or Google Ads this period — paid channels have been fully offline for 45 days, and 0 leads came through either platform. The blockage traces to 8 setup milestones that remain unresolved, the earliest dating to July 20; these cover payment verification, CRM build, conversion tracking, landing pages, and creative — all prerequisites before ads can run responsibly. Your Google Business Profile generated 55 direction requests from 106 impressions this period, which shows local search interest, but the call button is returning zero calls and is being investigated and corrected now. Website sessions held at 696 this period with a slight week-over-week uptick, which is encouraging given there is zero paid traffic supporting it. Once the outstanding milestones are cleared, paid campaigns are ready to launch and the pipeline will have active leads flowing into it.
